entries.2a050d05faf38358: Its management philosophy is 'Collect "thank yous."' and it regards highly transparent corporate management and thorough compliance as the basis of its management. As priority issues to address, it cites restoring its growth pace and consolidating its position as a premises infrastructure integrator. In the Telecommunications Business, its targets are acquiring new contracts for residence Wi-Fi services in multi-unit residential buildings and expanding market share, and for free Wi-Fi it is developing business-use demand from hotels, nursing care facilities, BCP measures and similar uses. Toward becoming a premises infrastructure integrator (communications × energy), it states that it will promote accelerated cross-selling of communications and energy through a reorganization into regional sales structures, and differentiation through a one-stop communications × energy service.

entries.31794909a8dc5776: It states that a major feature of the company group is that it has built a vertically integrated business model with the know-how to provide services end to end, from communications equipment development to building, operating and supporting customers' Wi-Fi environments, including sales of communications equipment it develops in-house. For customers, there is the assurance of being able to outsource services through one stop and shorter schedules from contract to service introduction; for the company group, know-how accumulates at each process and costs can be reduced through lower procurement costs at each stage, it states. In addition, it endeavors to reflect needs identified through direct inquiries from end users to the company group in its business strategy at an early stage.
entries.369688dda6c7b8d9: Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥13,664 million. By reportable segment, the Telecommunications Business was ¥13,162 million, the Real Estate Business ¥296 million, and Other (Renewable Energy (Electricity) Business) ¥206 million. The Telecommunications Business has a revenue structure that combines recurring revenue from long-term contracts with one-time revenue from service introduction, depending on the contract form.

entries.e04814393fab03c7: The core of this business is laying optical fiber lines in apartment buildings and installing Wi-Fi equipment to provide internet access to residents, and it also includes free Wi-Fi for nursing care facilities, commercial facilities and events, and construction of corporate networks. The company develops its communications equipment in-house and provides Wi-Fi environment construction, operation and customer support on an end-to-end basis. Consolidated subsidiary NOIS Inc. handles the intermediation of communications lines, and Feibo Wangtong Keji Gufen Youxian Gongsi handles product equipment development and call center operations.

entries.e262c791613dc733: Revenue has increased from ¥10,624 million in the fiscal year ended June 2022 to ¥13,664 million in the fiscal year ended June 2026. The Telecommunications Business accounts for more than 96% of revenue, the number of units installed in rental properties remained solid, and revenue from medical and nursing care fields and school projects is stated to have grown as well. The company's management policy is to create niche markets itself and, by raising its market share as a premises infrastructure integrator, to become a price maker. Since 2024, it has positioned the period as the fifth stage of growth, in which it consolidates its position from an independent Wi-Fi solutions provider to a premises infrastructure integrator.
